notes.title: The "up to date" update
notes.content: [h3]Bringing the Prologue up to date[/h3][p]The full game has been updated a few times since its 1.0 launch, and  we are bringing all these updates to the Prologue as well! That means a lot of balance changes and bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]This includes these updates, and many bug fixes not mentioned in these.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1830970/view/517463774534307658?l=english"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1830970/view/499441143215293428?l=english"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1830970/view/507318638682833789?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]Fixed 16:10 aspect ratio[/h3][p]The Prologue was not playable in 16:10 because the Play/Continue button was "behind" the game's title; and therefore, a run couldn't be started. This has now been addressed.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Play the full version[/h3][p]Check out the complete version here which contains a lot more content and ways of playing the game![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1830970/The_Last_Flame/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: V1.0 now available
notes.content:
[h3]V1.0 Full Version[/h3]
The full version of The Last Flame just released in 1.0. The game has received a dozen of updates during its Early Access, and now just received its biggest update ever with the full launch of the game! You can preview the full list of changes here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1830970/view/4443457735847051387?l=english

[h3]Grab the full version at 40% OFF![/h3]
Now is the perfect time to add The Last Flame to you library! The game now has a ton of content, received a lot of polish, and you can also grab a copy at its lowest price ever!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1830970/The_Last_Flame/

[h3]V1.0 Prologue[/h3]
The full version of The Last Flame has received many updates throughout its Early Access period, and we are now bringing some of those updates to the Prologue version as well!

Overall, all updates made during Early Access will be present in the Prologue with the exception of content updates. Here's what the 1.0 update brings to the Prologue:

[list]
[*] 5 New Languages Available (Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese and Russian)
[*] Recipe Locking system and Soft Ban Automatic System which increases the chance to see items, heroes, relics and origins that you are more likely to be interested in
[*] Improved Combat Recap
[*] Events revamp, 26 out of 27 events have received modifications, balance changes and totally new options
[*] 3 New Events
[*] Hundreds of balance changes.
[*] Improved active description
[*] New resolution for the 16:10 screen aspect ratio
[*] Adjustable keybinds
[*] You can now restart a run after completing it, and abandon a run from the main menu
[*] Performance improvements
[/list]

[previewyoutube=x2BtfXoj9n0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Prologue launches on January 8th!
notes.content:
Exciting news! I am very pleased to announce that the Prologue will launch on January 8th! Yes, that's right! You will be able to play the Prologue in less than 2 weeks! The Early Access launch will also be announced very very soon, so stay tuned for that!

[h2]Wishlist the Prologue![/h2]
It would mean a lot, if you can help us reach our wishlist goal for the Prologue. We are extremely close, and every wishlist helps tremendously! As I have announced in the past, if we reach our goal of 6,500, an [b]EXCLUSIVE FINAL BOSS[/b] will be available to challenge your best builds in the Prologue!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160826/501bf9dc9e956d39573da71cbcc9eb7914d856b9.png[/img]
[b]I am incredibly grateful for your support and enthusiasm! The community has been amazing for the game, and kept me extremely motivated throughout its development! Thank you for being a part of The Last Flame's journey, and helping it reach new heights![/b]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2517810/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160826/21ed57f0ac5bee4d26ee75c4b73d8e7d96aa7cf8.png[/img]
[h2]What's the Prologue all about?[/h2]
The prologue is a free version of The Last Flame that allows you to dive into the game before its early access!
If you played the Demo, here's what is new in the Prologue, and if you are new, I would highly recommend checking out the Prologue when it releases as it will give you a great overview of what to expect of the full game!

The Prologue will feature 2 new bosses, 1 new difficulty, 20% more content in the form of items, heroes, origins and relics, and of course the Final Boss if we manage to reach the 6,500 wishlists goal!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160826/6ac85d1ab626dcaf48fbaedd12d252cd597aaadd.png[/img]
